# Vulkan-Headers

Unmodified API declarations from KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers, tag v1.3.296,
commit `29f979ee5aa58b7b005f805ea8df7a855c39ff37`.

Only `vulkan_core.h`, `vk_platform.h` and their `vk_video` header dependencies
are vendored. Original per-file copyright/SPDX notices and the upstream license
files are retained. These declarations are not a graphics implementation.

Upstream: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/tree/v1.3.296
